title: Satire is Now the News
subtitle: Your author was featured in the American Prospect!
text:
The frontier psychiatrist is a daily health-themed publication. It also has a satirical tone, but not all the time. I'm working on an exciting piece. That's a lie. It's a pretty dull piece about retrospective studies, cats, and dogs. In the meantime, I have two updates for my readers, which I imagine you will find entertaining.

The first is letting you know about excellent journalism over at the American Prospect on the healthcare situation, which quotes yours truly, and the inimitable Dr Glaucomflecken, regarding the change healthcare disaster.

The article is linked here.

The other quick update is I have a new cover song available today! I did a version of Fast Car by Tracy Chapman, which is all the rage all over again.

You should listen to it, add it to playlists, listen to it again, and then force your friends to listen to it. I think this is what is called “ a call to action?”

Thanks for reading, on the daily. There is more exciting content tomorrow! Now, we are back to work building the future of AI-guided healthcare.

Prior coverage of the Change Healthcare cyber attack is available here. and here. and here. and here. and here. and here. and also here. Oh, and with an NFT, here. An overview of all the things that changed is available in an article from the other day.
